findings.statement: Rule 29.2(c) assigns transmission to the court within 10 days after filing; no participant service act or completed prosecutor-receipt finding is fabricated.

Sentence imposed, offense class for every conviction, completion/discharge status and date, and certificate-of-second-chance request intent are mandatory participant inputs. Their missing/provided/invalid states and exact Form 31(a)/continuation destinations are modeled without selecting any Form 31(b) decision.
